_about: Module 4 severity rules. RDD2022 has no severity labels, so these are transparent, adjustable heuristics in the spirit of pavement condition surveys (distress type x extent), not a trained model. See docs/MODULES.md.

type_weight._about: How serious each damage type is at full extent (potholes: safety + structural; alligator: structural fatigue; linear cracks: water ingress)

extent._about: Area-type damage uses box area / image area, linear cracks use box length / image size, both after perspective correction. Extent = log-scale position between that type's 10th and 95th percentile size in the India+Japan TRAINING labels (calibrated 2026-10-01), so a median-sized damage gets ~0.4 and only unusually large damage reaches 1.

perspective._about: Dashcam view: damage higher in the frame is farther away and looks smaller. Linear size is scaled by (H - horizon) / (y_centre - horizon), clamped to [1, max_factor]. horizon 0.45 = fraction of image height, estimated from India training boxes (1% of boxes start above 0.38, 5% above 0.52).

score._about: score = 100 * type_weight * (base + (1 - base) * extent) * (conf_floor + (1 - conf_floor) * confidence)

condition._about: Per-image condition index 0-100 (100 = no visible damage) = 100 * prod(1 - decay * score / 100). A heuristic proxy, not a PCI measurement.
